task: Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/source_a4.wav loaded (a 3-second 440 Hz sine tone, amplitude 0.5, mono 44.1 kHz). Modify the audio so that its pitch is increased from 440 Hz to 880 Hz without changing its duration. Save the result to: /home/user/Music/pitched.wav. The output must be a mono 44.1 kHz WAV file encoded as signed 16-bit PCM.
task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/source_a4.wav loaded (a 3-second 440 Hz sine tone, amplitude 0.5, mono 44.1 kHz).

Select the entire audio (Ctrl+A) and apply Effect > Change Pitch... (under the Pitch and Tempo submenu if present). Set Semitones (half-steps) = +12 (one octave up) so the pitch is raised from A4 (440 Hz) to A5 (880 Hz). Leave 'Use high quality stretching' at default. Click OK. The duration should remain 3.0 seconds.

Export the result to /home/user/Music/pitched.wav using File > Export > Export as WAV... with 'WAV (Microsoft) signed 16-bit PCM' at 44100 Hz mono. Accept any metadata dialog defaults.

verification.description: Dominant frequency raised to ~880 Hz (one octave up)
